scope: Actual resident ABI7 Raytrace Pass 3; diagnostic only; source marker_program is null

ordinary_rhs.contract: complete compiled RHS in original binding order; no Cell frames for Runs without selected multi-step recipes

values.match_count_scope: exact matcher outputs, private schedule invocations and accepted inline invocations are counted separately; none is committed mutations
values.scope: original control gates with witnessed saturation-local successor firing in one shared GPU identity domain
values.identities: shared hashcons/union; local recipe slots receive actual constructor results
values.execution: GPU control, parallel keyed Cell waves where admitted, ordered publication for noncommuting callbacks

limits: Encoder sampling/splitting perturbs timing; group shares describe this diagnostic, not an exact decomposition of the clean run.
Issued encoders can be zero-work indirect dispatches; they are not active kernel launches.
Command time minus covered encoder intervals is not pure barrier or CPU time.
CPU waits include GPU work and cannot be added to GPU seconds.
Private and ordinary execution paths and all result/history fields are checked against the frozen control.
Time-active fraction is not ALU occupancy, bandwidth saturation or matrix utilization.
Encoder segments can be split by preemption; their durations are summed, not their end-to-end envelope.
Profiling changes timing. Use an uninstrumented verified control for speedups.
Run metadata equality does not establish full graph or native semantic equality.
timeline.shader_time_basis: Instruments sampled shader timeline; encoder groups may fuse multiple kernels

cpu_samples.basis: stack sample counts within target GPU span, not exact CPU wall time; thread-state label alone does not identify blocking

counters.scope: time-weighted samples overlapping target GPU intervals or sampled shader timeline; other processes may contribute
